rows.comparison_note: Both timings use raw timed PAGEOUT total, before drain/retry; noswap vs zram: attempt time is primary; memcomp-swap vs zswap: first-nonpresent time is primary. zswap writes incompressible pages in the timed call, memcomp-swap may write them in a later untimed retry. Random noswap may reclaim no pages: undefined per-reclaimed time is not zero; zram raw-page storage is not memory saving. Memory consumption is start-minus-end MemFree+PCP from the shared seq fill-to-drained window, not a separate rand/rewrite measurement; both timings get their own E.4 test.
